notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 13215; AKU grapheme S0670 (AKU GR 594). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: S40 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 455. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
